versions.changelog:
Initial release — provides an operational readiness audit before shipping code.

- Runs a comprehensive 10-category checklist (logging, error handling, telemetry, feature flags, migrations, rollback, secrets, local-first storage, auth, update strategy).
- Produces a structured report: each item is marked PASS (with file:line evidence and named probe), GAP (with citation), or N/A (with justification tied to the scope).
- Final verdict groups findings as Blocking / Should-fix / N/A with reason / Passing.
- Never edits code automatically; only delivers recommendations and asks for confirmation before proposing fixes.
- Clearly distinguishes operational checks (`ship-it`) from code quality/diff reviews (`code-review`).
